title: Steel and amplified guitar: Bob Dunn, Dick Reinhart and Cossairos
summary: Amplification freed the steel guitar. Parker names Bob Dunn, Dick Reinhart, bassist Bert Dodson and Mexican violinist Fred Cossairos, and recommends a Victor record, Jig in G.
